violation_type.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)
violation_type.typical_finding: The fence gate had a locked placed and 3 zip ties.  The lock was opened, except, the gate could not be opened as the zip ties were attached holding the gate to the post.  The zip ties were removed during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: The fence gate had a locked placed and 3 zip ties.  The lock was opened, except, the gate could not be opened as the zip ties were attached holding the gate to the post.  The zip ties were removed during the inspection.

The gates to the outside play area need locks.  This will prevent children from opening the gate during outdoor time and possibly running into the streets.   Keys to the locks must be accessible to caregivers at all times during outdoor time. (no children in care)
Druring the inspection one gate leading out the playground was blocked by a ceramic planter and the other fence was found to be locked with a padlock from the outside with no key accessible.
The outside gate was open and the children had access to an apartment complex's parking lot.
Caregiver did not have immediate access to unlock gate when needing to exit.

The fence gate had a padlock, and the fence gate area had a material that was fastened to the other side of the fence gate.  The fence gate would not open. This was corrected at the inspection when the director cut off the material after removing the padlock.
